toolkit.name: Dynamics 365
toolkit.description: Dynamics 365 from Microsoft combines CRM, ERP, and productivity apps to streamline sales, marketing, customer service, and operations in one integrated platform

tools.name: Create Annotation
tools.description: Create a text or attachment note, optionally linked to a supported record.

input.title: CreateAnnotationRequest

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Parent record GUID; supply together with parent_type.

parent_type.title: Parent Type
parent_type.description: Supported parent record type for the note.

input.description: Parameters for creating a Dynamics 365 note.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a Dataverse task activity and return its selected representation.

select.title: Select
select.description: Comma-separated Dataverse task fields to return after creation. Defaults to activityid.

priority_code.title: Priority Code
priority_code.description: Task priority: 0 low, 1 normal, or 2 high.

scheduled_end.title: Scheduled End
scheduled_end.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: Create Account
tools.description: Creates a new account entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the new account to be created.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: The revenue associated with the account.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

creditonhold.title: Creditonhold
creditonhold.description: Indicates whether the account is on credit hold.

accountcategorycode.title: Accountcategorycode
accountcategorycode.description: The category code of the account.

tools.name: Create Case
tools.description: Creates a new case (incident) entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

input.title: CreateCaseRequest

title.title: Title
title.description: The subject or title of the case.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: A reference to the related account. Format: '/accounts(GUID)'

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: A reference to the related contact. Format: '/contacts(GUID)'

description.title: Description
description.description: A detailed description of the issue or inquiry.

prioritycode.title: Prioritycode
prioritycode.description: The priority level of the case (e.g., 1 for Low, 2 for Normal, 3 for High).

caseorigincode.title: Caseorigincode
caseorigincode.description: The source of the case. Valid values: 1 (Phone), 2 (Email), 3 (Web).

input.description: Request model for creating a case in Dynamics CRM.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

jobtitle.title: Jobtitle
jobtitle.description: The job title of the contact.

lastname.title: Lastname
lastname.description: The last name of the contact.

firstname.title: Firstname
firstname.description: The first name of the contact.

telephone1.title: Telephone1
telephone1.description: The primary telephone number of the contact.

mobilephone.title: Mobilephone
mobilephone.description: The mobile phone number of the contact.

address1_city.title: Address1 City
address1_city.description: The city of the contact's address.

emailaddress1.title: Emailaddress1
emailaddress1.description: The primary email address of the contact.

address1_country.title: Address1 Country
address1_country.description: The country of the contact's address.

address1_postalcode.title: Address1 Postalcode
address1_postalcode.description: The postal code of the contact's address.

address1_stateorprovince.title: Address1 Stateorprovince
address1_stateorprovince.description: The state or province of the contact's address.

tools.name: Create Lead
tools.description: Creates a new lead entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: A brief description or title for the lead.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user. Set explicitly when creating leads on behalf of other users in multi-user or automated workflows.

lastname.title: Lastname
lastname.description: The last name of the lead.

firstname.title: Firstname
firstname.description: The first name of the lead.

telephone1.title: Telephone1
telephone1.description: The primary telephone number of the lead.

companyname.title: Companyname
companyname.description: The company name associated with the lead. May be enforced as required by some CRM configurations; omitting it can cause the request to be rejected.

emailaddress1.title: Emailaddress1
emailaddress1.description: The primary email address of the lead.

tools.name: Create Opportunity
tools.description: Creates a new opportunity entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API. Some CRM configurations enforce `estimatedclosedate` and a transaction currency at the server level even though they are schema-optional; omitting them may cause the request to be rejected.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name or title of the opportunity. This is a required field.

description.title: Description
description.description: A brief description of the opportunity.

estimatedvalue.title: Estimatedvalue
estimatedvalue.description: The anticipated revenue from the opportunity.

estimatedclosedate.title: Estimatedclosedate
estimatedclosedate.description: The expected close date of the opportunity in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

customer_account_id.title: Customer Account Id
customer_account_id.description: The GUID of the related account (without curly braces). Optional.

customer_contact_id.title: Customer Contact Id
customer_contact_id.description: The GUID of the related contact (without curly braces). Optional.

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: The ID of the lead to retrieve (GUID format) Use the value exactly as returned by Dynamics CRM tools — do not reformat or truncate.

top.title: Top
top.description: Maximum number of leads to return

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: Number of leads to skip for pagination

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: OData filter criteria for leads (e.g., contains(fullname,'John')) Date filters require ISO 8601 format (e.g., createdon gt 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

select.title: Select
select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g., fullname,emailaddress1)

orderby.title: Orderby
orderby.description: Field to order by (e.g., createdon desc)

tools.name: Update Case
tools.description: Updates an existing case (incident) entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

title.title: Title
title.description: The subject or title of the case.

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the case to update.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

statuscode.title: Statuscode
statuscode.description: The current status of the case (e.g., 1 for Active, 2 for In Progress, 3 for Resolved).

description.title: Description
description.description: A detailed description of the issue or inquiry.

prioritycode.title: Prioritycode
prioritycode.description: The priority level of the case (e.g., 1 for High, 2 for Normal, 3 for Low).

tools.name: Update Lead
tools.description: Updates an existing lead entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API.

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the lead to update. Must be passed exactly as returned by Dynamics CRM lookup tools — no added braces or modified dash formatting.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: A brief description or title for the lead.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

telephone1.title: Telephone1
telephone1.description: Primary phone number of the lead.

companyname.title: Companyname
companyname.description: Name of the company associated with the lead.

emailaddress1.title: Emailaddress1
emailaddress1.description: Primary email address of the lead.

tools.name: Update Opportunity
tools.description: Updates an existing opportunity entity record in Dynamics CRM using the Web API. Some updates may be rejected if required relational fields (e.g., transactioncurrency) are absent from the record, even though they are not exposed as explicit parameters.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name or title of the opportunity.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's ID or 'me' for the authenticated user.

description.title: Description
description.description: A brief description of the opportunity.

estimatedvalue.title: Estimatedvalue
estimatedvalue.description: The anticipated revenue from the opportunity.

opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id
opportunity_id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the opportunity to update. Use the GUID exactly as returned by CRM lookup or list tools — reformatting the value will cause the update to fail.

salesstagecode.title: Salesstagecode
salesstagecode.description: The current sales stage (e.g., 1 for Qualify, 2 for Develop, 3 for Propose).

estimatedclosedate.title: Estimatedclosedate
estimatedclosedate.description: The expected close date of the opportunity in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

opportunityratingcode.title: Opportunityratingcode
opportunityratingcode.description: The rating of the opportunity (e.g., 1 for Cold, 2 for Warm, 3 for Hot).

tools.name: Query accounts
tools.description: List or filter Dynamics accounts with projection, ordering, and bounded results. Optionally include the matching count, expand related resources, or aggregate and group records. Returns an OData next link when another page is available.

top.title: Top
top.description: Maximum number of accounts to return

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: OData $apply expression for aggregation or grouping

tools.name: Query campaigns
tools.description: List, filter, expand, or aggregate Dynamics campaigns. Use this action to select campaign fields, order and bound results, include related records, request a matching count, or group and aggregate campaign data with OData. Results include an OData next link when another page is available.

top.title: Top
top.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return

tools.name: Query contacts
tools.description: List or filter Dynamics contacts with selected fields and ordering. Optionally include the matching count, expand related resources, or aggregate and group records. Results are bounded and include an OData next link when another page is available.

top.title: Top
top.description: Maximum number of contacts to return

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: OData $apply expression for aggregation or grouping

tools.name: Query Entity Data
tools.description: Query supported CRM collections and return one bounded page plus its next link.

top.title: Top
top.description: Maximum number of records to return, from 1 through 5000.

entity_set.title: Entity Set
entity_set.description: Dataverse collection to query: contacts, incidents, phonecalls, activitypointers, opportunities, or salesorderdetails.

tools.name: Get Caller Identity
tools.description: Return the connected Dataverse caller's identity IDs.

input.title: WhoAmIRequest
input.description: The current connected account's identity. Takes no parameters.
